headlines.description: — Brandon Lowe homered off Detroit closer Kenley Jansen with two outs in the ninth inning to lift the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 4-3 victory over the Tigers on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Lowe and Flores homer in the ninth off Jansen as the Pirates rally past Tigers 4-3

events.name: San Diego Padres at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Carson Benge hitting a two-run homer to conclude an impressive series, helping the New York Mets beat the San Diego Padres 4-2 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Carson Benge hits a two-run homer to help the surging Mets past the Padres, 4-2

headlines.description: — Kody Clemens and Brooks Lee had RBI singles in the seventh inning and the Minnesota Twins beat the Atlanta Braves 6-4 on Wednesday to sweep the three-game series.
headlines.shortLinkText: Clemens has 3 RBIs as the Twins beat the Braves 6-4 to sweep their three-game series

events.name: Chicago White Sox at Chicago Cubs

headlines.description: — José Urquidy pitched six innings of crisp, two-hit relief, rookie Braden Montgomery drove in two runs and the Chicago White Sox topped the crosstown Cubs 3-0 on Wednesday to salvage the finale of a three-game series at Wrigley Field.
headlines.shortLinkText: José Urquidy sharp in long relief, Braden Montgomery has 2 RBIs as the White Sox beat the Cubs 3-0

events.name: Arizona Diamondbacks at Boston Red Sox

headlines.description: — Nolan Arenado hit a tiebreaking broken-bat bloop single over a drawn-in infield to spark a two-run 10th inning, and the Arizona Diamondbacks avoided a series sweep by beating the Boston Red Sox 7-6 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Nolan Arenado's broken-bat bloop in 10th sparks Diamondbacks to 7-6 win over Red Sox

headlines.description: — Luis Arraez homered, Garrett Stubbs had two hits and an RBI and Aaron Nola tossed seven strong innings as the Philadelphia Phillies completed a three-game sweep of the Miami Marlins, 4-1 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Arraez homers, Nola works 7 strong innings to power the Phillies past the Marlins 4-1

events.name: New York Yankees at Baltimore Orioles

headlines.description: — Pete Alonso's drive down the left-field line in the seventh inning was ruled foul, and the New York Yankees took advantage of that reprieve, scoring twice in the top of the eighth to beat the Baltimore Orioles 5-3 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yankees edge the Orioles 5-3 after Pete Alonso's deep fly in the 7th is ruled foul

events.name: San Francisco Giants at Cleveland Guardians

headlines.description: — Victor Bericoto had an RBI single, Matt Wilkinson worked two innings as an opener in his major league debut against the team that drafted the left-hander and the San Francisco Giants beat the Cleveland Guardians 1-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Victor Bericoto's single and Matt Wilkinson's debut as an opener help Giants beat Guardians 1-0

events.name: St. Louis Cardinals at Cincinnati Reds

headlines.description: — Sal Stewart hit a three-run home run and the Cincinnati Reds added runs on a throwing error and an infield hit, rallying for a 5-4 win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sal Stewart's 3-run homer helps the Reds rally to beat the Cardinals 5-4

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Tampa Bay Rays

headlines.description: — Yandy Díaz hit a two-run homer, Drew Rasmussen earned his sixth consecutive win and Bryan Baker converted his 25th straight save opportunity to lead the Tampa Bay Rays to a 7-6 win over the Toronto Blue Jays on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Yandy Díaz homers, Drew Rasmussen earns 6th straight win as the Rays beat the Blue Jays 7-6

events.name: Athletics Athletics at Kansas City Royals

headlines.description: — John Rave hit a tiebreaking, bases-clearing double during a seven-run eighth inning, and the Kansas City Royals rallied past the Athletics 9-7 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: John Rave hits bases-clearing double in 7-run 8th and Royals beat Athletics 9-7

headlines.description: — Dominic Canzone, Josh Naylor and Taylor Ward each drove in two runs as the Seattle Mariners bounced back from an embarrassing loss by beating the Milwaukee Brewers 7-5 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mariners bounce back from humiliating loss, pound Dustin May early to beat Brewers 7-5

headlines.description: — Cade Cavalli struck out 11 over six innings for his second double-digit strikeout game in a row and retired the final 11 batters he faced as Washington beat Texas 6-0 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cade Cavalli has second double-digit strikeout game in row as Nationals beat Rangers 6-0

events.name: Los Angeles Angels at Houston Astros

headlines.description: — Ethan Pecko struck out four in his major-league debut, five Houston relievers pitched shutout ball for five-plus innings and Christian Vázquez homered as the Astros beat the Los Angeles Angels 3-2 on Wednesday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Pecko fans 4 in MLB debut, Vázquez hits 7th homer as the Astros beat the Angels 3-2

events.name: Los Angeles Dodgers at Colorado Rockies

headlines.description: — Mookie Betts homered and capped a three-hit night with an RBI single in the 10th inning, and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the Colorado Rockies 6-4 on Wednesday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mookie Betts homers and has RBI single in 10th as Dodgers beat Rockies 6-4 for 3-game sweep
